meta.title: Guan Yin Fortune Sticks - S-Jiffy
meta.description: The Guan Yin Fortune Sticks consist of 100 sticks. Worship Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, and ask about affairs, seek counsel and pursue good fortune while avoiding harm with a single draw.
desc: The Guan Yin Fortune Sticks consist of 100 sticks. Worship Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, and ask about affairs, seek counsel and pursue good fortune while avoiding harm with a single draw.
ui.1: First recite your wish silently in your heart with sincerity and a pure mind, then draw a stick.
ui.2: This tool's data comes from public traditional culture materials and is for entertainment reference only.
